title: sorbus andersonii
intro: Sorbus andersonii, commonly known as the Himalayan rowan, is a species of flowering plant in the family Rosaceae. The plant is used in traditional medicine due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. Its therapeutic actions include treating various conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems. The bioactive constituents present in Sorbus andersonii include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
